points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 威廉·格莱斯顿出生于利物浦一个富有的商人家庭，父亲是约翰·格莱斯顿，一位成功的奴隶贸易商和后来成为国会议员的商人。格莱斯顿在伊顿公学接受教育，后进入牛津大学基督教堂学院学习。在大学期间，他表现出色，获得诗歌双一等荣誉学位，并成为牛津大学辩论社的主席。这一时期，他深受保守派思想影响，成为托利党的坚定支持者，并在1832年首次当选为纽波特选区的国会议员。
points.descriptionEn: William Gladstone was born in Liverpool into a wealthy merchant family. His father, John Gladstone, was a successful slave trader and later Member of Parliament. Gladstone was educated at Eton College and later at Christ Church, Oxford University. At Oxford, he excelled, winning the double first in Classics and becoming President of the Oxford Union Debating Society. During this period, he was deeply influenced by conservative thought and became a staunch supporter of the Tory Party, winning his first seat in Parliament as MP for Newport in 1832.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 进入下议院后，格莱斯顿迅速在政坛崭露头角。他最初担任财政大臣的私人秘书，随后在罗伯特·皮尔领导的保守党政府中担任多项职务，包括贸易委员会主席和殖民大臣。这一时期，他逐渐从保守派立场转向自由主义，特别是在1845年支持废除《谷物法》的决定上，这标志着他与保守党的决裂。格莱斯顿在这一阶段展现出卓越的行政能力和对经济问题的深刻理解，为他日后成为自由党领袖奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After entering the House of Commons, Gladstone quickly rose to prominence in politics. He initially served as private secretary to the Chancellor of the Exchequer, then held several positions in Robert Peel's Conservative government, including President of the Board of Trade and Colonial Secretary. During this period, he gradually shifted from conservative to liberal positions, particularly in his support for the repeal of the Corn Laws in 1845, which marked his break with the Conservative Party. Gladstone demonstrated outstanding administrative abilities and deep understanding of economic issues during this phase, laying the foundation for his later leadership of the Liberal Party.

points.title: 财政大臣
points.description: 在帕默斯顿和约翰·罗素领导的自由党政府中，格莱斯顿四次担任财政大臣。他推行了一系列财政改革，包括降低关税、简化税收制度，并努力实现预算平衡。他的财政政策以'和平、减税和改革'为原则，极大地促进了自由贸易和经济发展。格莱斯顿在这一时期还推动了多项社会改革，如废除公共职务的购买制度，提高了政府效率。他的财政成就使他成为当时最受尊敬的政治家之一，也为他日后成为首相铺平了道路。
points.descriptionEn: In Liberal governments led by Palmerston and John Russell, Gladstone served as Chancellor of the Exchequer four times. He implemented a series of financial reforms, including reducing tariffs, simplifying the tax system, and striving for budget balance. His fiscal policies were guided by the principles of 'peace, retrenchment, and reform,' significantly promoting free trade and economic development. During this period, Gladstone also pushed for several social reforms, such as abolishing the purchase of public offices, which improved government efficiency. His fiscal achievements made him one of the most respected politicians of the time and paved the way for his future premiership.

points.title: 首次首相任期
points.description: 1868年，格莱斯顿首次出任英国首相。他的政府推行了一系列重要改革，包括废除爱尔兰国教特权、实行秘密投票、改革文官制度、普及初等教育等。在外交政策上，他采取'小政府'原则，减少军事干预，关注国内事务。格莱斯顿特别关注爱尔兰问题，尽管他试图通过改革缓解爱尔兰紧张局势，但未能解决根本矛盾。这一时期，他的自由主义改革奠定了现代英国福利国家的基础，但也因爱尔兰政策和外交上的'东方危机'而面临批评。
points.descriptionEn: In 1868, Gladstone became Prime Minister of the United Kingdom for the first time. His government implemented a series of important reforms, including abolishing the privileges of the Church of Ireland in Ireland, introducing secret ballot, reforming the civil service, and promoting elementary education. In foreign policy, he adopted a principle of 'little Englandism,' reducing military intervention and focusing on domestic affairs. Gladstone paid special attention to the Irish issue, but despite his attempts to alleviate tensions through reforms, he failed to resolve the fundamental contradictions. During this period, his liberal reforms laid the foundation for the modern British welfare state, but he also faced criticism over his Irish policy and the 'Eastern Crisis' in foreign affairs.

points.title: 第二次首相任期
points.description: 1880年，格莱斯顿再次出任首相。他的政府继续推进自由主义改革，包括扩大选举权、改善工人条件等。在外交方面，他处理了埃及危机，最终导致英国占领埃及。格莱斯顿最著名的行动是1884年发起的爱尔兰自治运动，试图给予爱尔兰有限的自治权，但这一提案在下议院被否决。这一时期，他的政府面临诸多挑战，包括布尔战争和经济衰退。格莱斯顿的第二次首相任期以爱尔兰问题为中心，显示了他对帝国扩张的矛盾态度和对民族自决原则的坚持。
points.descriptionEn: In 1880, Gladstone returned to power as Prime Minister. His government continued to advance liberal reforms, including expanding voting rights and improving working conditions. In foreign affairs, he handled the Egyptian crisis, which ultimately led to British occupation of Egypt. Gladstone's most famous action during this period was his 1884 initiative for Irish Home Rule, attempting to grant Ireland limited self-governance, though this proposal was defeated in the House of Commons. During this term, his government faced numerous challenges, including the Boer War and economic recession. Gladstone's second premiership centered on the Irish issue, revealing his contradictory attitude toward imperial expansion and his commitment to the principle of national self-determination.

points.title: 晚年政治
points.description: 82岁时，格莱斯顿第四次出任首相，成为英国历史上最年长的首相。他的主要议程是推动爱尔兰自治法案，尽管面临党内分裂和强烈反对，他仍坚持这一政策。1893年，爱尔兰自治法案在下议院通过，但在上议院被否决。这一时期，格莱斯顿的健康状况逐渐恶化，他于1894年辞职，结束了长达60年的政治生涯。晚年，他将更多时间投入到宗教和古典文学研究中，并致力于慈善事业。格莱斯顿的政治遗产包括他对自由主义原则的坚持、对帝国扩张的批判以及对爱尔兰自治的持续追求，这些影响深远地塑造了现代英国政治。
points.descriptionEn: At the age of 82, Gladstone became Prime Minister for the fourth time, making him the oldest British Prime Minister in history. His main agenda was to push for Irish Home Rule, and despite facing party division and strong opposition, he remained committed to this policy. In 1893, the Irish Home Rule Bill passed in the House of Commons but was defeated in the House of Lords. During this period, Gladstone's health gradually deteriorated, and he resigned in 1894, ending his 60-year political career. In his later years, he devoted more time to religious and classical literary studies and engaged in charitable work. Gladstone's political legacy includes his commitment to liberal principles, his critique of imperial expansion, and his persistent pursuit of Irish Home Rule, which profoundly shaped modern British politics.

supporter.zh: 格莱斯顿被视为英国最伟大的政治家之一，他的自由主义改革奠定了现代英国民主制度的基础。支持者赞扬他坚定的道德原则、对贫困者的同情以及推动社会正义的努力。他的财政政策促进了经济发展，他的教育改革普及了知识，他的文官制度改革提高了政府效率。格莱斯顿对爱尔兰自治的追求体现了他对民族自决原则的尊重，尽管未能成功，但为后来的爱尔兰独立运动铺平了道路。他的政治生涯展现了理想主义与现实政治的结合，成为后世政治家的楷模。
supporter.en: Gladstone is regarded as one of Britain's greatest statesmen, whose liberal reforms laid the foundation of modern British democracy. Supporters praise his firm moral principles, sympathy for the poor, and efforts to promote social justice. His fiscal policies promoted economic development, his educational reforms spread knowledge, and his civil service reforms improved government efficiency. Gladstone's pursuit of Irish Home Rule reflected his respect for the principle of national self-determination, and although unsuccessful, it paved the way for later Irish independence movements. His political career demonstrated the combination of idealism and practical politics, becoming a model for future statesmen.

critic.zh: 批评者认为格莱斯顿的政策存在严重矛盾和局限性。他的爱尔兰政策虽然出于善意，但忽视了北爱尔兰新教徒的意愿，加剧了宗教冲突。他的外交政策前后不一，从支持帝国扩张到批评布尔战争，缺乏连贯性。格莱斯顿对帝国的矛盾态度被批评为虚伪，他一方面批评帝国扩张，另一方面又扩大了英国在非洲的殖民地。此外，他的道德说教有时被视为伪善，特别是考虑到他父亲曾从事奴隶贸易。批评者还指出，他的改革虽然进步，但未能解决英国社会根本的不平等问题。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gladstone's policies contained serious contradictions and limitations. His Irish policy, though well-intentioned, ignored the wishes of Northern Irish Protestants and exacerbated religious conflicts. His foreign policy was inconsistent, ranging from supporting imperial expansion to criticizing the Boer War. Gladstone's contradictory attitude toward the empire has been criticized as hypocritical—he criticized imperial expansion while simultaneously expanding British colonies in Africa. Additionally, his moralizing was sometimes seen as hypocritical, especially considering his father's involvement in the slave trade. Critics also point out that while his reforms were progressive, they failed to address fundamental social inequalities in Britain.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，格莱斯顿被定义为维多利亚时代最具影响力的政治家之一，体现了19世纪英国政治的复杂性。他既是虔诚的基督徒，又是务实的政治家；既是帝国扩张的批评者，又是殖民地的管理者。历史学者认为格莱斯顿代表了自由主义的高峰，他的政治生涯反映了英国从贵族政治向民主政治过渡的关键时期。在流行文化中，格莱斯顿常被描绘为'人民的威廉'，与保守党对手迪斯雷利形成鲜明对比。他的形象融合了道德权威与政治智慧，成为英国政治传统中不可或缺的一部分，影响了后世的政治理念和制度设计。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Gladstone is defined as one of the most influential politicians of the Victorian era, embodying the complexity of 19th-century British politics. He was both a devout Christian and a pragmatic politician; both a critic of imperial expansion and an administrator of colonies. Historians view Gladstone as representing the pinnacle of liberalism, and his political career reflects the critical transition in Britain from aristocratic to democratic politics. In popular culture, Gladstone is often depicted as 'the People's William,' forming a stark contrast with his Conservative rival Disraeli. His image combines moral authority with political wisdom, becoming an integral part of British political tradition and influencing later political ideas and institutional designs.

self.zh: 我的首要原则是：永远做你认为正确的事情，无论后果如何。
self.en: My first principle is: never do anything against conscience, even if the state demands it.

others.zh: 格莱斯顿是英国历史上最伟大的政治家，他不仅改变了英国的政治，还改变了英国人的思想。
others.en: Gladstone was the greatest statesman in English history; he changed not only the politics of England but the minds of the English people.
